name: qBittorrent Manager
description: Browse, search, add and control torrents on a qBittorrent instance without exposing qBittorrent credentials or network access to the browser. All communication is proxied through the Jellyfin server and gated by Jellyfin authentication.
overview: Remotely manage a qBittorrent instance from within Jellyfin.
